subject: Sparkline AI — Field Lab onboarding & enablement workshop
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@sparkline.ai>
To: hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sparkline AI — Field Lab onboarding & enablement workshop

Hi Hiro / Marcus / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the low latency on the recommendation flows. Sparkline is excited to move to a short field lab to validate the integration and measure cost/latency in our app. We typically run a 2-week field lab: first week is a hands-on enablement workshop + integration sprint, second week is shadowing/metrics collection.

High-level asks from our side:
- A 4-hour enablement block for our engineers and solutions architects (walkthrough of the Redwood runtime, batching controls, and prefix-caching).
- Temporary sandbox with a dedicated model variant and 100k token budget for tests.
- A quick checklist for procurement (any PO details or a simple MOU).

Proposed dates: Aug 17-31 (we can compress if you prefer). Can you confirm who from Redwood should lead the enablement and what materials we should review beforehand?

Attached: brief agenda we use for partner field labs (FieldLab-Agenda-v1.pdf).

Cheers,
Alex Morgan
Head of Partnerships
Sparkline AI

--
Alex Morgan
Sparkline AI | alex@sparkline.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@sparkline.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sparkline AI — Field Lab onboarding & enablement workshop

Alex — thanks for the clear note and the agenda. Excited to run this with Sparkline. Quick answers below and next steps.

Who will lead: Marcus (solutions) will run the enablement workshop, I will co-own the sandbox setup and observability wiring, and Karthik will handle performance tuning and quantization recommendations during the sprint.

We can do the 2-week field lab Aug 17-31. Proposed workshop block: Monday Aug 17, 10:00–14:00 PT (4 hours, with 30m break). Agenda we'll use: intro to Redwood serving runtime, batching & cache patterns, connectivity and private keys, demo of real-time latency tuning, hands-on pairing exercise.

Sandbox & budget: yes — we can provision a dedicated sandbox tenant and allocate a 100k token test pool. I will request sandbox creds and a short 'sandbox-access-instructions.txt' once legal/PO is in place.

Procurement / MOU: we can do a short MOU for the field lab scope — if you send a contact for procurement we can fast-track a one-page MOU (non-binding) and a purchase order for any reserved infra beyond the sandbox quota.

Pre-read: please review our short partner-playbook section on prefix caching and rolling fallbacks. Link to materials and sample scripts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdfExampleFieldLabMaterials

Next steps (action items):
- Alex: confirm procurement contact + sign-off on dates (by Tue Aug 11).
- Marcus: prepare workshop deck and two hands-on exercises (deliver by Aug 12).
- Hiro: request sandbox, create initial observability dashboard, and share creds after MOU.

Attachment: sandbox-access-instructions will follow.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai
